notes: Retrieval only, not QA accuracy. Abstention questions (_abs) excluded, as in the official retrieval evaluation. Session level: evidence = answer_session_ids, one item per session, first 2,000 characters embedded. Turn level: evidence = turns marked has_answer, one item per turn; questions with no such turn excluded. One fresh store per question holding only its haystack. Runs executed on one machine, possibly concurrently with other runs.
